findings: The public fixed mean strain constrains the zero Fourier mode, while nonzero modes can mechanically relax through compatible periodic displacement.
Eigenstress diag(0,3,-3) gives zero forcing for all x-axis calibration modes, so pointwise clamping and mechanical equilibrium are exactly equivalent there.
Christoffel elimination gives B(n)=3-f^T[3I+5nn^T]^-1f; the independent six-strain KKT minimization uses correct off-diagonal tensor factors and transverse compatibility constraints.
Cahn-Hilliard mobility multiplies q² times the relaxed chemical curvature, giving stable decay with B>=0. The compatible shear direction(0,1,1) has B=0, and direction y has B=1.875.
